intro: Visited, worked with me, or hired me? Leave a short note. Notes appear here after I've read and approved them.
empty: No notes yet. Be the first to leave one.

form.heading: Leave a note

errors.name: Please enter a name (2 to 60 characters).
errors.role: Please keep "who you are" under 80 characters.
errors.links: Links aren't allowed in notes. Please remove them and try again.
errors.rate: You've sent a few notes today already. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.busy: A lot of notes are waiting for approval right now. Please try again later.
errors.default: That didn't go through. Please try again in a moment.

note: Copy for the Visitor Notes section (js/notes.js, api/feedback.js). Notes are moderated: nothing a visitor sends is public until you approve it at /notes-admin.html. The limits (name 2-60, role up to 80, message 10-500, no links) are enforced by the server in lib/notes.js; keep these messages in sync if you change them.
